pr-local.evidencePolicy: fresh per-platform results at tested commit

setup.fixtures: Disposable project/control/scratch directories; macOS isolated Keychain; Linux private D-Bus and gnome-keyring-daemon. Never use user secrets.

paths.observable: Guarded SDK read/write/edit and bash work in the project, private scratch and literal /tmp; ordinary outside writes stay denied.
Sibling runtime and credential controls inside writable temp remain protected; an unmaterializable denied path refuses launch.
Direct and indirect writable runtime aliases are rejected; project ancestors cannot be replaced between launches.
Host temporary files remain inaccessible with Outside Off while assigned project and private scratch work.
A guarded command retrieves a synthetic item through macOS Keychain or a disposable Linux Secret Service without changing real credentials.

Outside project = Write (the Subagents default): a user cache dir is written and cleaned; a sibling repo cannot be removed or moved (macOS edits it in place, the Linux fallback keeps it read-only); controls stay unwritable.
